issues.legal_issue: A continuance measure covering land subject to requisition when the prior emergency law expired continues the requisition even when the underlying requisition order was for a limited duration.
material_facts: The property had been requisitioned under emergency powers and remained subject to the requisition on the date the emergency law expired.
The requisition order specified a duration tied to the war and a period afterward.

The continuance measure defined covered land by whether it was subject to requisition when the emergency law expired and provided that such land would remain subject to requisition until the measure expired.
The appeal challenged the lower courts’ conclusion that the measure did not continue this requisition.
issues.conclusion: The requisition continued under the measure despite the limited duration specified in the original order. The appeal was allowed, and the matter was remanded for consideration of the other issues that the lower appellate court had not decided.
issues.legal_principle: Under clauses 2(3) and 3 of the Requisitioned Land (Continuance of Powers) Ordinance, 1946, land subject to requisition when the Defence of India Act and its rules expired remained subject to requisition until the Ordinance expired, whether the original order was for a limited or indefinite duration. A non obstante clause ordinarily has a close connection with the operative provision, but it does not cut down clear operative language; where that language has only one plain and grammatical meaning, the non obstante clause may clarify the provision rather than limit its scope. No earlier cases are relied on.

predicates.appeal_challenges_requisition_continuity: The proceeding is an appeal challenging a decision about whether a requisition continued under a later continuance measure.
predicates.property_subject_to_requisition_at_prior: The property remained subject to an existing requisition when the earlier law authorizing requisition expired.
predicates.continuance_measure_covers_property_by_t: The later measure covers property according to whether it was subject to requisition when the earlier law expired.

issues.definition: When an appeal challenges the continuation of requisition, and the property was subject to requisition at the earlier law’s expiry and falls within the later measure’s status-based coverage, the requisition continues until that measure expires.
